notes: Scrap no longer piles up on your commander's back; it only counts in the balance at the top of the screen.
A red ! now bobs over your commander when health is down to 3, so you can step out of a fight before being knocked down.
When your commander is knocked down on a level with a med bay, a big red ! shows over them, the screen edge flashes red and the phone buzzes.

The first time you open the game it now shows a Preparing the outpost screen that downloads everything for offline play, with a real progress bar, a Wi-Fi choice on mobile data, and a Retry if the connection drops.
Build pads no longer hide behind buildings or walls.
Walled attack levels now face the camera side.
In the opening film, your commander now turns to look round by shuffling his feet instead of sliding them.
On new defend levels, turrets now stand right beside the road they guard, with their build pads tucked in behind them.
